title: NV-DL enforced
description: User story under REQ-179 for DEFINE step 3 PR 8 (spec section 4 NV-DL row, section 11.7 US-17902). The rcf-lite ruleset carries NV-DL-ADM-01..05 with `refuseByDefault: true` and `overrideChannel: recordedInChain`. ADM-01 is the bundle refusal on an unfrozen tree; ADM-05 is the bundle skip of impacted FBS; ADM-02..04 are D4 and D3 findings surfaced through the admissibility wrap. `freeze.override` (bundle --override) and an `--ack` reason (readiness / freeze) satisfy `recordedInChain`. readiness compute still runs and prints under refusal; 0.29.0 informational posture on the compute is unchanged (ADR-4123).
asA: an operator of the DEFINE stage gates
iWant: the five NV-DL rules to refuse by default with a recorded-in-chain override channel so a build verb cannot proceed on an unfrozen tree without a documented reason
soThat: the ruleset's intent (ruling-sheet item 1) is enforced in code and the readiness compute still prints its diagnostics under a refusal

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given ruleset.json, when read, then NV-DL-ADM-01 to 05 carry refuseByDefault true and overrideChannel recordedInChain.
[failure] given an unfrozen tree, when a build verb runs under the admissibility gate, then it refuses citing NV-DL-ADM-01.
[happy] given freeze.override present, when the same verb runs, then it proceeds and names the override.
[must-not] given readiness, when the gate refuses, then the compute still runs and prints (0.29.0 informational posture unchanged).
